description:
Move the pinned-read behaviour suite into the git module's suite and point it at the module API instead of the bridge.

## Background

- `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_revision_tests.rs` exercises `GitRevisionResolver` through `new` (`:69`, `:92`, `:126`) and `with_git_program` (`:157`, `:237`, `:351`, `:392`, `:426`, `:461`), and matches `GitRevisionError` variants. The type is a bridge over `GitCheckout`.
- The module's behaviour suite is `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_module_tests.rs`; `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/main.rs` lists the suite's modules.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The suite's cases live in `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_module_tests.rs` and build `GitCheckout` values with `Git::default()` or `Git::with_program`; `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_revision_tests.rs` and its module line no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every moved case keeps its assertions, matching the module's error variants.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Pinned-read behaviour suite moves into the git module suite
